_status: URLs to be confirmed by the team
_comment: Where to check a notice at the source, by the claimed sender. A route matches on agency ids (from agencies.json) or agency types. Shown in suspicious and cannot_verify replies. The first matching route wins.

routes.en: Genuine Income Tax notices carry a DIN. Check it on incometax.gov.in under 'Authenticate notice/order issued by ITD'.
routes.hi: असली आयकर नोटिस पर DIN होता है। इसे incometax.gov.in पर 'Authenticate notice/order issued by ITD' में जाँचें।

routes.en: Look up the case by its CNR number on ecourts.gov.in.
routes.hi: ecourts.gov.in पर CNR नंबर से मामला खोजें।
